name: Discord Wastes: Expanse
summary: The fractured outer plains of the Discord Wastes, where instability begins.
description: The Discord Wastes Expanse is the outermost region of the Wastes, where Discord energy first begins to warp the terrain. Cracked plains, unstable ground, arcane winds, and flickering anomalies dominate the landscape. Muramite observers maintain distant watchposts, while Discord manifestations roam freely. The Expanse is dangerous but navigable, serving as the threshold into deeper Discord corruption.
